intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi slept tight and the tooth fairy visited. ✨
But today, Kimi's body is making the FUNNIEST sounds...

scenes.title: Hic! Hic! Hiccups!
scenes.caption:
Hic! Hic! Hic!
Kimi's tummy is playing the drums.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I have the hiccups, Mom! How can I stop hiccups?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Hold your breath and count to three. One... two... three!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Scare me. It might cure the hiccups!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Peek-a-boo! ...Are you okay now? 😜

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Yeah, I seem fine now. ...HIC! Oops. 😂

scenes.title: Achoo! Yaaawn!
scenes.caption:
The flowers are blooming, and Kimi's nose
is very, very ticklish...

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Achoo! I'm sneezing, Mom. My nose is ticklish!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Bless you! Cover your mouth with your hand.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Excuse me! ...And now I'm yawning, Mom. 😪

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Your yawn made others yawn, too. Yawning is contagious!

scenes.title: The Burp Contest
scenes.caption:
Dinner was yummy. So yummy that...
BUUURP!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I burped, Mom. Hehe. 😆

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's not polite to burp at the table.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: But burping is fun!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't burp like that. It's embarrassing! 🙈

scenes.title: Who Cut the Cheese?
scenes.caption:
Prrrrt! A mysterious smell fills the room.
Everyone looks at... DAD!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Oh! What is this smell? 🤢

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Who farted? It wasn't me!

lines.speaker: dad
lines.text: It wasn't me. Why do you keep looking at me?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Ta-da! Dad's going to fart! Hold your nose! 🤭

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: We need to open the window. Right now! 💨

scenes.title: The Booger Digger
scenes.caption:
Dig, dig, dig... Kimi is mining for gold.
In her NOSE?!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Stop picking your nose. Don't eat your boogers! 😱

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: The booger would not come out, Mom.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Clean it off with a tissue. If you pick too much, your nose can bleed.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Okay, Mom. Tissue it is. 🧻

scenes.title: The Stubborn Poop
scenes.caption:
Push... push... nothing.
The poop just doesn't want to come out today.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, my stomach hurts, but I can't poop. 😣

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Try to push. ...I think you're constipated.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: You haven't eaten any vegetables. You should drink a lot of water.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Okay, I'll eat my broccoli. I'll try again later. 🥦

ending.title: What a Noisy Day!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: Big Kid Skills! 📞✂️
